card.$description: Cards default to a hairline border with this very subtle shadow. Reach for shadow.lifted only when card is genuinely lifting.

focus.$description: Focus ring around any focused control. Always 3px spread of accent at 32% alpha.

accent-glow.$description: Optional outer glow under primary CTAs. Warp signature.

input.$description: v0.6 — input field shell shadows. Composed: lit-edge (rest) + focus/error halo (active state). Apply to .lumen-field wrapper, never to the inner <input>.

lit-edge.$description: 1px lit top edge — steals the glass-pane reflection trick from glassmorphism without committing to full glass. Dark mode only; no-op on light.

focus.$description: v0.6 — focus halo on .lumen-field wrapper. Same recipe as shadow.focus, namespaced for inputs so future theming can diverge.

error.$description: v0.6 — error halo. Painted on focus when [data-invalid=true]; replaces (not stacks with) shadow.input.focus.

success.$description: v0.6 — success halo. Reuses the focus recipe; reserved for explicit post-validation success affordances.
